name: io.github.gizmos-quest/gizmos-audacity-mcp
title: Gizmos Audacity
description: Safe local audio editing, analysis and production in Audacity 3.7 through mod-script-pipe.

environmentVariables.name: AUDACITY_EXE

environmentVariables.name: AUDACITY_CONFIG

environmentVariables.name: AUDACITY_FFMPEG
environmentVariables.description: Optional full path to ffmpeg for loudness measurement and decoding.

environmentVariables.name: AUDACITY_FFPROBE
environmentVariables.description: Optional full path to ffprobe for container and stream metadata.
